name: Architecture Baseline
focus: Project structure, workstreams, and technical anchors are defined
evidence: architecture.md updated and tracker sheets initialized

name: Single-Leg IK Validation
focus: FK and IK behavior are validated for a single leg in simulation
evidence: single-leg controller behaves repeatably and compile/lint checks pass

name: Raise to Nominal
focus: Robot can transition safely from motor zero to working posture
evidence: nominal pose command path and validation scenario are defined

name: Trajectory and Phase Library
focus: Path generation and time-law logic are separated and reusable
evidence: trajectory and time-law modules are coupled through locomotion

name: Simulation Gait Integration
focus: Gait generation produces stable leg targets in simulation
evidence: world-based validation exists for nominal stance and commanded motion

name: Teleop Controller Integration
focus: Operator commands can trigger posture changes and locomotion
evidence: controller state machine and input mappings are validated

name: Hardware Integration
focus: Mechanical, electronics, and control stack align on real hardware
evidence: bring-up, wiring, and standing behavior are verified

name: Full-Robot Walking
focus: Integrated walking behavior is demonstrated with evidence
evidence: simulation and hardware validation records exist for walking
